The number of people who have visited the International Space Station has grown over time, which is why different sources report different totals. The most recent figure comes from NASA's official ISS visitors page [d3], which states that 280 individuals representing 23 countries and five International Partners have visited the station (as of October 2024). This is consistent with Wikipedia's figure of 279 individuals from 22 countries as of March 2024 [d2]. Earlier sources report lower counts: space.com reported 258 individuals from 20 countries as of May 2022 [d7], a Wikipedia list recorded 244 individuals as of September 2021 [d4], and a Kennedy Space Center blog from October 2020 cited 240 astronauts from 19 countries [d8]. NASA's main ISS page also notes "over 260 individuals" have visited [d9], which aligns with the mid-range figures. The discrepancies across sources reflect the passage of time rather than factual errors, as the ISS continues to receive new visitors.
